conventions: Each executor is a fresh GPT-5.6 Sol one-shot context. Copy the named territory and Consultant-state fixtures into __RUN_DIR__. Replace __RUN_DIR__, __CONSULTANT_HOME__, and __TERRITORY__. __CONSULTANT_HOME__ is the complete run-local replacement for ~/.consultant; real ~/.consultant, unrelated repositories, external temporary directories, credentials, and live services are off-limits. Scripted replies are consumed in order in the same headless transcript. Fresh reviewers use GPT-5.6 Terra and receive only plan.md plus its explicit references. No-skill arms forbid every installed skill. Frozen-old baseline arms may read only the recorded old Consultant snapshot and also forbid installed skills.
